text.content:
Building Night City's way off the planet.

Headquarters: Site office at NCX Morro Rock
Industry: Aerospace, suborbital flights and orbital launch
Leadership: Site director: Ingrid Solheim
In Night City: Building the massdriver at NCX Morro Rock with Arasaka as its partner

The massdriver dream of 2045 became NCX Morro Rock, Night City's spaceport, approved in 2068. Orbital Air security guards the half-built launch track, and its partner on it is Arasaka, which means the two are fighting over it.

Only the runway is finished, taking suborbital and long-haul flights from a terminal of prefab buildings. The spaceport is due to open in 2072, along with the Star Line extension. Site director Ingrid Solheim is behind schedule, over budget, and dreading the next Arasaka inspection.

Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.01, 13
